F-04 / Impact
Impact & responsibility

Measuring impact
with the rigour of performance.

Impact is not an afterthought. It is built into our investment model, tracked through KPIs, audited every year and published.

KPIs tracked
24
Review
Annual, audited
Report
Published every spring
Exclusions
7 sectors
01 Commitments

Four commitments,
each with a dated target.

I/01

Equality

Accelerate the professionalisation of women’s sport and guarantee equal treatment in every holding.

Target

40% women in portfolio leadership bodies by 2028.

I/02

Governance

Independent boards, transparent pay, zero tolerance on compliance.

Target

100% of holdings with an audit committee by 2027.

I/03

Communities

Root clubs in their communities: development, access to sport, local partnerships.

Target

1% of portfolio company revenue dedicated to local programmes.

I/04

Climate

Measure, then reduce the footprint of travel, venues and events.

Target

Carbon footprint covering 100% of the portfolio by 2027.

02 Progress

Where we stand,
unrounded.

Progress measured across the whole portfolio as of 30 Sep 2026. The marker shows each commitment’s target.

Illustrative data

03 KPIs

Twenty-four KPIs,
eight published here.

KPIs are collected from each holding, checked by the team and audited by a third party before publication.

ThemeIndicatorFrequencySource
EqualityShare of women in leadership bodiesAnnualPortfolio company reporting
EqualityPay gap for comparable rolesAnnualSocial audit
EqualityBroadcast hours of women’s competitionsHalf-yearlyBroadcasters
GovernanceBoard independenceAnnualBoard minutes
GovernanceReported compliance incidentsOngoingCompliance function
CommunitiesRegistered players supportedAnnualFederations, clubs
ClimateEmissions, scopes 1 to 3AnnualCarbon footprint
ClimateShare of low-carbon travelAnnualPortfolio companies
04 Responsible investment

What we refuse,
what we require.

Sector exclusions

  • Unregulated sports betting
  • Tobacco and vaping products
  • Controversial weapons
  • Thermal coal
  • Entities under international sanctions
  • Serious human rights abuses
  • Sponsorship harmful to athlete health

Built into every stage

ESG due diligence

100-day plan
